remarks: Freshly painted furnished studio available in the desirable Crosswinds building in Stamford. This bright 8th floor unit features beautiful wood floors and expansive city views, offering a comfortable and efficient living space. Heat and hot water are included, and the rental comes with one off-street parking space. Flexible lease terms provide added convenience. Ideally located near downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, dining, and major highways for easy commuting. Internet, cooking gas, heat and hot water all included in rent.
